Dogecoin has become more and more popular since 2019 with the public support of technology tycoon Musk. It is classified as a "memecoin" and is one of the top ten cryptocurrencies by market value.
Dogecoin (English: Dogecoin, coin market code: DOGE, currency symbol: Ð), also known as Dogcoin and Dogecoin, is a cryptocurrency derived from the Internet meme Doge, launched in 2013[2][3].
